units: pixels (x right, y down) and seconds; no metric scale

camera.evidence: phase correlation of upper image (y<600) vs frame 0, every 3rd frame: |shift| < 0.01 px in all frames
camera.view: side view of a shop entrance; cart moves parallel to the image x axis at constant image row (constant depth), consistent with the 2D label

moving_objects.name: shopping_cart
moving_objects.description: grey wire shopping cart with red handle and red seat, black castors; the only moving object
moving_objects.reference_point: bbox_cx/bbox_cy (centre of full-cart pixel bbox) recommended as proxy of the rigid-object origin; wheels_cx = centre of castor extents (y>=840) is an alternative; both give the same frame-to-frame x displacement within ~0.5 px
moving_objects.motion: pure horizontal translation to the right (+x); bbox top y=637 and bottom y=884 constant every frame; starts from rest and speeds up steadily (per-frame dx grows from 0 at frame 1 to ~30 px at frame 59); never stops, still fully in frame at frame 59 (right edge x=1874)

pixel_size.note: length = full x extent handle tip to basket front; grows slightly 221->235 px as the cart moves right (more of its side/end visible off-axis); at frame 0 length 223 px, height 248 px (y 637-884). Wheelbase (outer castor x extent) 184-206 px. Depth/width across the image not measurable in this side view.

events.note: first non-zero displacement between frames 1 and 2 (1 px); motion onset is between frame 1 and 2 (could be at frame 0-1 with sub-pixel motion)

events.event: cart begins passing in front of ride platform (image overlap only, no contact)
events.note: cart right edge x1=1088 reaches platform left edge x~1085 at frame 22; handle tip (x0) overlaps orange machine frames ~35-38; cart is nearer the camera, never occluded

events.event: end of clip, cart still moving and accelerating

perspective: 2D scene label; floor shows perspective (converging grout lines) but the cart moves at constant depth along image x, so one px scale applies to the cart's motion
